newsitem.title: USA: HSB increases dividend, buyback program.
newsitem.headline: HSB increases dividend, buyback program.

text.p: HSB Group Inc on Monday said it was increasing its quarterly dividend by three cents to $0.60 a share and boosting its share buy-back program to cover two million shares, from one million.

The parent of the Hartford Steam Boiler Inspection and Insurance Co Monday posted net income of $16.4 million, or $0.80 a share, beating analysts' consensus estimate of $0.75, according to a First Call survey.
The result compared with net income of $13.4 million, or $0.66 a share, in the second quarter of 1996.

HSB's operating income surged 65 percent to $0.71 a share from $0.43 a share. The operating results excluded investment gains of $3.4 million in 1997 and $5.1 million in 1996 and $1.4 million income in 1996 from the Radian International operations, which the company has discontinued.

The insurer's gross earned premiums increased 8.4 percent to $149.2 million in the quarter from $137.7 million. The sum of HSB's insurance losses and expenses as a percentage of its insurance revenues was 91.8 percent, while its expense ratio stood at 47.9 percent for the quarter.
HSB said it would pay the increased dividend on October 30 to shareholders of record on October 10.
A spokesman said the company had bought back 340,000 shares so far this year under the previous repurchase program of one million shares.
The company's stock was down 3/16 at 54-1/16 late Monday afternoon.
